---
title: "2 - Process ATO Layers"
format: html
jupyter: python3
---

This step converts the raw ATO CSVs and statewide TAZ geometry into canonical
web-ready artifacts in `_data/processed/ato/`.

The processor:

- combines Statewide, Wasatch Front, Cache, Dixie, Summit Wasatch, and Iron ATO
  CSVs into one metrics Parquet file
- normalizes each accessibility metric within `ScenarioYear` and `ModelArea`
- builds simplified PMTiles polygons for the thematic fill layer
- builds separate boundary PMTiles for readable TAZ outlines
- writes a manifest with model-area bounds, record counts, metric ranges, and
  file paths used by the web app

```{python}
from _src.process_ato import build_processed_assets

summary = build_processed_assets()
{
    "metric_rows": summary["metric_rows"],
    "tile_features": summary["tile_features"],
    "boundary_features": summary["boundary_features"],
    "processed_dir": summary["processed_dir"],
}
```

The output of this step is the source-of-truth processed dataset. The Vite app
still needs a browser-serving copy, which is created in the next step.
